openQuestions: No past-question step in any of the seven files. The builder adds the step as soon as the question papers and keys are supplied as PDFs. By the brief's own test G2 is therefore not done yet.

Mains questions are all practice questions written by us and labelled so. Each carries the sample's fields plus two extra keys, earnsMarks (two examples and one case or report) and model (the model answer; 150 to 200 words).
Steps not built because they need assets or a human: cover image, video, simulation, news, essay, tour and survey steps from the sample.
